subject: GREEN: vlinux.ld _vlinux_base symbol (structural)
description: Add PROVIDE(_vlinux_base = .) right after the 0x02000000 base in runtime/linux/vlinux.ld so loader.c's overlap check has a single source of truth for vlinux's own region bounds (paired with the existing _stack symbol as the end bound), instead of duplicating the magic addresses in C. Structural only -- verify via a rebuild + the existing U1 boot test before/after.
